mfa.description: Choose which verification methods people can use and who must turn it on. Tightening the policy doesn't sign anyone out: they're asked to set it up at their next sign-in.
mfa.allowAll: Allow every method the platform offers
mfa.allowAllHint: New methods the platform enables later are allowed automatically.
mfa.requiredRoles: People with these roles must turn it on
mfa.requiredRolesHint: Roles held through groups count too.
mfa.nonCompliant_one: {{count}} user must turn it on but hasn't set it up yet.
mfa.nonCompliant_other: {{count}} users must turn it on but haven't set it up yet.
mfa.confirmNonCompliant_one: {{count}} user will be asked to set up a verification method at their next sign-in.
mfa.confirmNonCompliant_other: {{count}} users will be asked to set up a verification method at their next sign-in.
mfa.confirmStranded_one: {{count}} user only has methods that are no longer allowed and no recovery codes, so they won't be able to sign in until an administrator resets their MFA.
mfa.confirmStranded_other: {{count}} users only have methods that are no longer allowed and no recovery codes, so they won't be able to sign in until an administrator resets their MFA.
